content:
OpenSearch Service oﬀers previous generation instance types for users who have optimized their
applications around them and have yet to upgrade. We encourage you to use current generation
instance types to get the best performance, but we continue to support the following previous
generation instance types.

• You can use the T2 instance types only if the instance count for
your domain is 10 or fewer.
• The t2.micro.search  instance type supports only Elasticse
arch 1.5 and 2.3.
• The T2 instance types do not support encryption of data at rest,
ﬁne-grained access control, UltraWarm storage, cold storage,
cross-cluster search, or Auto-Tune.
Tip
We often recommend diﬀerent instance types for dedicated master nodes and data nodes.
